questions.q: Which Tableau skill transfers most directly to the Tableau Next visualization builder?
options: Writing SQL against Tableau Server's repository
Installing and configuring Tableau Desktop drivers
Choosing chart types, encoding with color, and dragging fields to rows, columns, and marks
Managing Tableau Server node topology
questions.explain: The drag-and-drop builder with filters, marks, columns, and rows is familiar, so visualization judgment carries over directly.

questions.q: In Tableau Next, where do calculated fields and business definitions primarily live?
options: In a semantic model that many visualizations share
Inside each individual chart, copied every time
In a local file on the analyst's laptop
Only in a Salesforce validation rule
questions.explain: A semantic model holds objects, relationships, and business definitions. Visualizations build on it rather than each carrying its own copy.

questions.q: Which data foundation does Tableau Next build on?
options: Only SOQL queries typed into each chart
Only Excel files stored on SharePoint
A Tableau Server extract repository
Data 360 (formerly Data Cloud), including data model objects, data lake objects, and calculated insight objects
questions.explain: Tableau Next reads data from Data 360. CSV uploads are stored there as data lake objects, and external sources reach it through Data 360 connectors.

questions.q: How does this lesson describe the AI comparison between Tableau Next and Tableau Desktop/Cloud?
options: Only Tableau Desktop has any AI features
The difference is one of integration: Tableau Next integrates Agentforce skills into the platform, while the other products have their own AI features
Tableau Next has no AI features
AI is identical in every Tableau product
questions.explain: Both families have AI features. The point is that Tableau Next is built with Agentforce integration on the Salesforce platform.

questions.q: Roughly, what does a Tableau Desktop workbook map onto in Tableau Next?
options: A single email attachment
A Salesforce validation rule
Separate assets in a workspace: a semantic model, visualizations, and dashboards
A Data 360 identity resolution ruleset
questions.explain: Concerns bundled in a workbook are split into separate assets, so one governed semantic model can serve many visualizations.
